text: Azores Airlines is an airline of the SATA group: the European Commission lists Azores Airlines among the group's operating subsidiaries, controlled by its holding company (SATA Holding), and SATA Holding itself describes the airline as the asset it is selling in the privatisation process.
short: Azores Airlines is an operating subsidiary of the SATA group (SATA Holding)

source.name: European Commission press release: State aid: Commission approves €453.25 million Portuguese restructuring aid in favour of SATA Group (IP/22/3525)
source.quote: with a holding company replacing SATA Air Açores in controlling its operating subsidiaries (SATA Air Açores, Azores Airlines and SGA)

additionalSources.name: Herald News (Reuters/O Jornal): Eight investors eye majority stake in Portugal's Azores Airlines
additionalSources.quote: Eight investors have expressed interest in acquiring a majority stake in small carrier Azores Airlines, parent company SATA Holding said on Tuesday
